scenes.headline: 7-Zip won't update itself
scenes.say: 7-Zip users: this free app never updates itself, and older copies have a serious bug.

scenes.headline: A booby-trapped .xz file
scenes.body: Opening it could let an attacker run code on your PC.
scenes.say: The flaw is in how 7-Zip opens XZ archives. A booby-trapped file could let an attacker run code on your computer.

scenes.headline: High, out of 10
scenes.say: The US vulnerability database rates it seven point eight out of ten. That's high.

scenes.headline: Fixed in 7-Zip 26.02
scenes.body: Out since June 25. No attacks reported as of July.
scenes.say: The fix is version twenty-six point zero two, out since June twenty-fifth. As of the July reports, no attacks had been seen.

scenes.headline: The risk: apps that never update.
scenes.body: Old copies sit for years. Apps that bundle 7-Zip code need their own fix.
scenes.say: Analyst note: the bigger risk is apps that never update, sitting on your PC for years. And programs that bundle 7-Zip's code need their own fix.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
scenes.say: Tonight: open 7-Zip, then Help, then About. If it's older than twenty-six point zero two, download the new one from seven zip dot org. Run the installer.

scenes.headline: The security story behind the headline.
scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
